text.autoconfig.chestesp.title: ChestESP Settings
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.enable.@:
This setting allows you to completely disable ChestESP.
ProTip: If you go to Options > Controls > Key Binds, you can set up a keybind to do this more quickly.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.style.@T:
Controls how ChestESP will highlight chests.
Boxes only: Chests will be highlighted with a colored box around them.
Lines only: Chests will be highlighted with a line going from your crosshair to the chest.
Lines and boxes: Both of the above.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.fill_box:
When enabled, boxes are filled with a transparent color.
Turn this off for outline-only ESP.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.outline_:
When enabled, boxes are drawn with a colored outline.
If both fill and outline are off, outline is used anyway so ESP stays visible.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.fill_opa: How opaque filled boxes are, from 0 (invisible) to 100.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.outline_: How opaque outlines, tracers, and labels are.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.through_:
When enabled, ESP is drawn through blocks.
Turn off to only highlight containers you can already see.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.max_dist: Hide containers farther than this many blocks from the camera.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.fade_by_: Far containers become more transparent so the screen stays readable.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.show_lab: Draw the container type above each box.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.show_dis: Append distance in meters to labels.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.show_fil:
Append filled/total slots when the client already has the inventory.
Vanilla usually only sends that after you open the container.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.label_ma: Don't draw text on containers farther than this.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.max_labe: Only the closest N labels are drawn so the screen stays readable.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.min_y.@T: Hide containers below this world height.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.max_y.@T: Hide containers above this world height.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.min_item:
Hide containers whose known inventory has fewer filled slots.
Ignored when the inventory was never synced to the client.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.valuable:
When the inventory is known, only show containers that match the item filter.
Unknown inventories still show.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.item_fil:
Comma-separated item ids or paths, e.g. diamond,netherite_ingot,totem_of_undying.
Leave empty to use the default valuables list.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.scan_int: How often to rescan already-loaded block entities. 5 ticks = 4 times per second.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.notify_n: Play a quiet UI sound when a new loaded container enters range.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.hide_ope:
Hide containers you already right-clicked this session.
This is only local memory, not a server check.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.opened_c: Color used for containers you already clicked, if they are still shown.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.highligh: Draw the closest container a bit brighter.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.tracers_: When using lines, only draw one tracer to the closest container.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.chroma.@: Cycle colors over time instead of using the per-type colors.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.show_hud: Show a small count of nearby containers in the top-left.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.hide_whe: Don't draw world ESP while a screen (inventory, pause, etc.) is open.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.chest_co: Normal chests will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.trap_che: Trapped chests will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.ender_ch: Ender chests will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.chest_ca: Minecarts with chests will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.chest_bo: Boats with chests will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.barrel_c: Barrels will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.pot_colo: Decorated pots will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.shulker_: Shulker boxes will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.hopper_c: Hoppers will be highlighted in this color.
Minecarts with hoppers will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.dropper_: Droppers will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.dispense: Dispensers will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.crafter_: Crafters will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.furnace_: Furnaces, smokers, and blast furnaces will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.brewing_: Brewing stands will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.lectern_: Lecterns will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.bookshel: Chiseled bookshelves will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.jukebox_: Jukeboxes will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.shelf_co: Item shelves will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.vault_co: Trial vaults will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.suspicio: Suspicious sand and gravel will be highlighted in this color.
text.autoconfig.chestesp.option.plausibl:
Help me improve ChestESP by contributing to its anonymous usage statistics.
These statistics help to answer questions like:
- "how many people are still on [old Minecraft version], do I need to backport this?"
- "what percentage of installations support [shiny new feature], is it too early to use that?"
- "is there a setting that most players change? that should probably be the new default."
None of the data is personal or identifiable. None of it is sold.
All of it stays in the EU (I'm self-hosting Plausible in Germany).
There are no cookies or persistent identifiers (see plausible.io for how that works).
Here is the full list of what's collected:
- ChestESP version
- Minecraft version
- Fabric/NeoForge version
- OS version
- Cloth Config version
- Mod Menu version (if installed)
- Sodium version (if installed)
- Sinytra Connector version (if installed)
- ChestESP settings
- Game type: singleplayer/multiplayer/Realms/LAN
 (without revealing the world name or server address)
- Language
Of course you can verify all of this in the source code.
Look for this file: net.wimods.chestesp.util.PlausibleAnalytics.java
